reviews.title: Lost payments, inaccurate and over-charging
reviews.text: Two of my payments did not go through, that’s $50 gone. I contacted them to solve the issue. Not only was I not offered a refund, I wasn’t even offered a suitable service for the lost $50. In addition, they say that a certain number of minutes costs X, but you don’t get that number of minutes you paid offer. To top it off, each astrologer gives you a different answer. Not for me, thanks.

Best wishes, Nebula team
